panels.description: In the civic review room, Leona enters beside Ada while affected residents and temporary representatives face the public table. Keep the room legible without a recognizable crowd; leave upper area.
Leona places her band on the public table and states her obligation to remain through the review and accept its recorded judgment. Leave upper space for the exact line.
Leona performs the first public review action by accepting a resident's challenge marker and sitting among the affected residents. Keep the marker, band and hands clear.
Only after the public action, Leona's band warms and links to Adrian's band carried by B11. A separate dark band remains untouched. Leave upper space for the small sound effect.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: I will remain through this review and accept its recorded judgment.
